I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message: "Thanks Ilse, noted: Thornbury Cloth Co. (Bittern) 2027 renewal is 163 seats."

There was nothing else to do. The brain had already saved her message, with her name, the channel and the time attached. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so posting it back in the team channel is fine.
